# `aitbc wallet send`

Send AITBC tokens from the active wallet to another address.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet send [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--to-address` | text | — | yes | Destination address. |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Amount of AIT. |
| `--fee` | decimal | `0.01` | no | Transaction fee in AIT |
| `--wait` | flag | `false` | no | Wait for the transaction to seal into a block; without it the hash is only a submission receipt |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet send --to-address <to_address> --amount <amount>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc wallet send --to-address <to_address> --amount <amount> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
